full_text_review.scope: All selected loose text, complete gzip streams, and all text members of ZIP archives; archive member paths and disguised Office formats checked in the first pass. No model deserialization.

initial_extraction_review.excluded: Manuscript drafts, manuscript-authoring documents, private discussion archives, local credentials, host control queues and duplicate API readbacks. Scientific protocols and experiment reports remain evidence.
initial_extraction_review.scope_note: Signature and filename checks, plus format and provenance inspection. Models were not executed or deserialized for this review.

supplement_review.personal_context: Only founding-statement recollections explicitly approved by the author were found in the added material. Their English/Chinese sources and excerpt JSON retain them.
supplement_review.paper_directory: Six explicitly approved research PNGs only; no manuscript or draft text files.
supplement_review.omissions: Marked at each edited document location and in JSON metadata; source positions indexed in PUBLIC_OMISSIONS.json.
supplement_review.excluded: Manuscript text and drafts, writing/submission discussions, private conversation locators, credentials/local state and raw experimental payloads.
supplement_review.scope_limit: Signature checks and manual review of flagged text and all added PNGs; scientific result reports are intentionally public. This is not a claim that automated scanning can prove absence of every possible secret.

previous_edition.data_preview: Not changed or recopied in this supplement; prior extraction review remains recorded above.

source_review.credential_and_private_locator_scan: The scoped source increment was checked for recognized live key prefixes, private keys, quoted credentials and private chat/file locators.
source_review.mixed_documents: Source and public hashes, omission locations and reasons are documented in the two public manifests.
